cases: TC-1 · AC-1 after-cutoff Friday skips weekend and Monday holiday; delivery is 2 later business days · bookedAt 2026-07-03T15:00, transitDays 2, holidays [2026-07-06] → shipDate 2026-07-07, deliveryDate 2026-07-09
TC-2 · AC-2 before cutoff on a business day ships that day; empty holiday list; 1 transit day · bookedAt 2026-07-01T09:00, transitDays 1, holidays [] → shipDate 2026-07-01, deliveryDate 2026-07-02
TC-3 · AC-3 time exactly 14:00 is not before cutoff · bookedAt 2026-07-01T14:00, transitDays 1, holidays [] → shipDate 2026-07-02, deliveryDate 2026-07-03

TC-4 · one minute before cutoff ships same business day; smallest transitDays 0 so delivery equals ship · bookedAt 2026-07-01T13:59, transitDays 0, holidays [] → shipDate 2026-07-01, deliveryDate 2026-07-01
TC-5 · one minute after cutoff ships the next business day · bookedAt 2026-07-01T14:01, transitDays 1, holidays [] → shipDate 2026-07-02, deliveryDate 2026-07-03

TC-6 · Sunday booking ships the next business day; listed Monday holiday is the middle item and is skipped · bookedAt 2026-07-05T09:00, transitDays 1, holidays [2026-01-01, 2026-07-06, 2026-12-25] → shipDate 2026-07-07, deliveryDate 2026-07-08

TC-7 · holiday that blocks the next ship day is first; a later holiday in the middle is not a delivery day · bookedAt 2026-07-03T15:00, transitDays 2, holidays [2026-07-06, 2026-07-08, 2026-12-25] → shipDate 2026-07-07, deliveryDate 2026-07-10

TC-8 · last day of December after cutoff; January 1 holiday is last in the list, so ship the following Monday · bookedAt 2026-12-31T15:00, transitDays 1, holidays [2026-07-06, 2026-11-26, 2027-01-01] → shipDate 2027-01-04, deliveryDate 2027-01-05

TC-9 · isBusinessDay: picked holiday first, middle and last is false; unlisted weekday true; Saturday and Sunday with an empty list false · isBusinessDay(2026-01-01, [2026-01-01, 2026-07-06, 2026-12-25]) → false; isBusinessDay(2026-07-06, same) → false; isBusinessDay(2026-12-25, same) → false; isBusinessDay(2026-07-07, same) → true; isBusinessDay(2026-07-04, []) → false; isBusinessDay(2026-07-05, []) → false
TC-10 · last day of a month before cutoff, 1 transit day lands on the 1st of the next month · bookedAt 2026-04-30T13:59, transitDays 1, holidays [] → shipDate 2026-04-30, deliveryDate 2026-05-01

TC-11 · leap day is a Thursday business day; 2 transit days are Friday 2024-03-01 then Monday 2024-03-04 · bookedAt 2024-02-29T13:59, transitDays 2, holidays [] → shipDate 2024-02-29, deliveryDate 2024-03-04

TC-12 · single-item holiday list; booking on that Monday before 14:00 still ships the next business day · bookedAt 2026-07-06T09:00, transitDays 1, holidays [2026-07-06] → shipDate 2026-07-07, deliveryDate 2026-07-08

TC-13 · whole-number forms 3 and 3.0 are both valid and give the same dates: Thursday, Friday, then Monday · bookedAt 2026-07-01T09:00, transitDays 3 and separately 3.0, holidays [] → both return shipDate 2026-07-01, deliveryDate 2026-07-06
TC-14 · Saturday morning is not a ship day even though the time is before 14:00 · bookedAt 2026-07-04T09:00, transitDays 1, holidays [] → shipDate 2026-07-06, deliveryDate 2026-07-07
TC-15 · named error invalid transitDays for a negative value and for a non-whole value · transitDays -1 → throws Error invalid transitDays; transitDays 1.5 → throws Error invalid transitDays
TC-16 · named error for an input field other than bookedAt, transitDays or holidays · input field note → throws Error unknown field: note
